name: Cox Woodworking
old_description: Cox Woodworking was founded in 1981 by master cabinetmaker Terry Cox. He is still hanging around; designing, drafting, talking with clients, and working in the shop. Over the years we have grown into a 4500 square foot shop with several highly skilled cabinetmakers and the resources to build any project our clients can imagine.
about:
Cox Woodworking operates from a 4,500-square-foot shop in Westmoreland, New Hampshire. The company was founded in 1981 by master cabinetmaker Terry Cox, who remains actively involved in design, drafting, client consultation, and shop work.

The shop produces custom cabinets and architectural millwork, fabricating windows, doors, custom moldings, gates, pillars, curved work, and turnings in any wood species. A team of several skilled cabinetmakers handles projects ranging from individual pieces to whole-house packages that include luxury kitchens, baths, libraries, wine cellars, home offices, and entertainment centers.

The firm serves high-end residential clients across New York, New England, and beyond, delivering architectural millwork for luxury homes. Past projects have been featured in publications such as New York Times Magazine, Boston Home Magazine, Antiques Magazine, and House & Garden.

Cox Woodworking emphasizes a commitment to long-term customer satisfaction and personal service, driven by a desire to complete every project to the highest standard. The founder’s hands-on approach extends from initial design through final installation.
